_comment: Edit these to change pricing everywhere. No code changes needed.
_discount: Dealer cost = list price x this. 0.40 = 60% off Palma list.
_install: FILL THESE IN before quoting. Flat dollars per opening; transom_adder is added on top of the base tier when the opening has a transom.
_default_finish: Used when a quote does not name a finish.
_pipeline: Step-by-step door configurator. frame_depths maps each offered depth to its Palma jamb upcharge row (null = standard jamb, no charge); a depth left out is not offered. Palma lists no 5-5/8 jamb for steel (only 5-1/4), so steel skips 5.625. smooth_only_depths: the book sells these jambs in smooth only. fire_rated_panel_list: list price per slab for the fire-rated upcharge — not in the Palma book; while null the rep enters it on the quote. sidelite_width_in / transom_height_in size the transom glass area.
_quote_defaults: Added to every opening unless the spec prices that row itself or lists the row in "skip_defaults": ["sill", "hinges", "brickmould"]. Hinges are per door slab. Brickmould length follows the opening (101" with a transom or a 7'/8' system, otherwise 84") and its finish follows the door's.
